snippet.title: "Vietnam War" official trailer
snippet.description:
New "Vietnam War" open world singleplayer FPS game is now on Steam!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1837480/Vietnam_War/

Features squad command, 50 vehicles, 1000km2 map with hundreds of handmade villages and bases.
In this game player is not the center of the universe with units moving and fighting independently.

Thanks for the support!
Thorium Game Lab
